youtube.aciklama: Randomized trials directly comparing communication approaches are not possible, because the choice belongs to the family; for example, a 2014 Cochrane review found no studies of auditory-verbal therapy that met its criteria. Observational studies show that outcomes vary over a very wide range in every approach; the common finding is that early and full access to language is decisive, whatever the channel. The choice belongs to the family, informed neutrally about all the options.
